name: Project Timesheet Matrix
prompt:
"Build a 'Project Timesheet Matrix' app. The raw data input is a flat table where employees log hours: Employee Name, Date, Project Name, and Hours Worked.

The app must pivot this flat data into a matrix view where:

Each unique Employee Name is a row.

Each unique Project Name becomes a dynamic column header.

The intersecting cells display the sum of hours that employee worked on that project.

Include a 'Total Hours' column at the far right and a 'Total Project Hours' row at the bottom.

Add a date-range picker at the top to filter the matrix by week."

thought_process.interpretation: I am acting as an Expert React Developer creating a business intelligence dashboard for resource management. The goal is to transform a standard flat log of time entries into a sophisticated cross-tabulated matrix, allowing managers to see project distribution and resource allocation at a glance. I prioritized a responsive, high-performance UI that can handle dynamic column generation and real-time filtering.
assumed_from_scratch: A comprehensive mock dataset of 300 time entries
A robust pivot table engine for calculating row/column/grand totals
A week-aware date range filtering system
thought_process.skill_suggestions: Future iterations could include a 'Heatmap' component for the matrix cells to identify over-allocated employees, and an 'Export to CSV' utility to integrate with external payroll systems.
